Linear rewrite: the direct translation grows 15.5x on 'a.' repeated (starts after '.'/'-' rescan the key run) and 15.7x on long space runs (two adjacent [ \t]* runs). Line-start, line-end, '#', bare-terminator and '(' lookups are cached so repeated assignments on one line stay linear.

dataAssetMechanism.reason: Pi loads extensions through jiti (tryNative: false for compiled builds, see @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent dist/core/extensions/loader.js), so JSON import attributes and runtime file reads relative to import.meta.url are avoided; generated modules compile into dist/**/*.js, which package.json files already covers
dataAssetMechanism.layout: byte-for-byte JSON copies in packages/redact/data/pii/*.json (not packed); generated modules in packages/redact/src/pii/data/*.ts that export the parsed data; a generator script and a test asserting the generated data deep-equals the JSON copies
dataAssetMechanism.packaging: no manifest change needed: dist/**/*.js and NOTICE are already in files

divergences: Only the text fallback is ported; tree-sitter syntax decisions (node_text, literal mapping, syntax-decided references, PII identifier protection) are deferred.
No enable switch, request-scoped activation, configuration layering, or detection cache.
Ranges and the marker-length comparison use UTF-16 code units instead of UTF-8 bytes; short non-ASCII values render as '*' runs where the source printed [REDACTED].
token.jwt, credential.url-password, credential.webhook-url, the assignment fallback, and the PEM END search use linear scanners equivalent to the source patterns.
normalizeRedactionConfig keeps sensitiveFields as written and normalizes when matching; issues are returned instead of logged.
File-name handling splits paths on both '/' and '\\'.
User rule patterns are JavaScript RegExp source with optional flags i/m/s/u.

The 'line-break position' acceptance check is verified as an unchanged sequence of CR/LF characters with every masked line no longer than its input line, because shorter replacements move absolute offsets.
